message: FORGE-WIN-2.6 requires a PATH-first whoami.exe stub, but forge.cmd deliberately invokes %SystemRoot%\System32\whoami.exe by absolute trusted path; the stub cannot intercept it, while changing production to PATH lookup would weaken the binding fail-closed guard. Please authorize a test-only launcher rewrite to PATH-resolved whoami.exe or specify another deterministic fixture.

notes: Correct objection — my PATH-whoami-stub instruction was wrong (forge.cmd invokes System32\whoami.exe by absolute trusted path; a PATH stub cannot intercept it, and weakening it to PATH lookup would break the fail-closed guard). Resolved by the corrected criterion: the converge TEST regex-patches the elevation-guard block out of its own test_shim copy (as it already does for FORGE_LOCAL_APP_DATA), isolating the convergence path. forge.cmd unchanged; the guard stays verified by the elevated-refuses test. windows-hook-gates is now GREEN.
